panels.description: Nayah plants an emergency route marker and clips a safety line in place while Sitara steps over the warning flags. Sitara’s separate TJ follows low across the snow, thermal sensor band facing the buried sensor. Leave upper corners clear.

Sitara kneels beside the tripod fastening a retrieval line to the sensor case; her fingers work quickly while the TJ scans the surface. A dark blue seam widens beneath the tripod. Leave upper-right and lower-left clear.

The ice slab drops. Sitara falls to one knee, catching the sensor case as the line jerks tight; Nayah braces against the route marker and cannot reach her without entering the unstable section. Leave the upper-left clear for the sound effect and upper-right clear for Nayah’s balloon.

Large reveal: blue ice falls into darkness beneath Sitara, exposing a black metal hatch stamped FALCON and a buried drill housing shuddering below. Sitara grips the sensor and ice edge; her small separate TJ stands at the hatch. Leave upper-right clear.
